name: Thomas vs Reference CLI Public Demo Pack
description: Standardized head-to-head pack for public comparison videos.
protocol: Use the same machine, same network, and fresh installs for both competitors.
Use equivalent model tier where possible and show the selected model on-screen.
Paste prompts exactly as written with no rescue prompting beyond the task prompt.
Capture full-screen video and publish raw logs + scorecard artifacts.

tasks.title: Repository Bugfix + Tests
tasks.success_criteria: Code change merged in workspace and relevant tests pass.
tasks.prompt: Find one real failing or brittle test in this repository, implement the smallest correct fix, run the most relevant tests, and report exactly which files changed with a short rationale.

tasks.title: Multi-step Product Change
tasks.success_criteria: Implements a user-visible improvement and provides a commit-style summary.
tasks.prompt: Implement a user-visible improvement in this project that requires edits across at least two files, validate it with tests or checks, and return a commit-style summary with risk notes.

tasks.title: Settings Mutation From Chat
tasks.success_criteria: Assistant changes a setting by chat command and the UI reflects the new state without manual clicking.
tasks.prompt: From chat only, change a visible UI setting (for example model profile or theme), then prove the UI state changed and summarize exactly what state changed.

tasks.title: Long-Horizon Batch/Background Task
tasks.success_criteria: Task runs asynchronously and reports completion with artifact/output evidence.
tasks.prompt: Run a long-horizon background task (batch/asynchronous mode), generate a concrete artifact file in the repository, and report completion only after verifying the artifact exists.

tasks.title: Tool Use: External + Filesystem
tasks.success_criteria: Uses at least one external source and one filesystem action to produce a structured output artifact.
tasks.prompt: Use one external information source and one local filesystem action to create demo_external_compare.json containing timestamped findings and clear source attribution.
